card_comparison: Eleven posed positions are represented in source order in SRC-TOP-WORKSHOP: two warm-ups, Problem 1, its explicit variation, Problems 2-6, and two covering-space presentation-complex problems. Five exact statements reuse P-TOP-WORKSHOP-HR-W1, P-TOP-WORKSHOP-HR-W2, P-TOPSU15C, P-5AXU3, and P-TOP-WORKSHOP-HR-05; six packet-specific statements are source-local cards.
known_extractor_defects: MinerU drops several arrow glyphs in maps such as Y -> X and S^1 -> S^1; the surrounding domain/codomain syntax makes the intended map notation unambiguous.

The cyclic presentations at the end are rendered as malformed angle-bracket notation; the cards normalize the visible x | x^2 and x | x^6 presentations to standard group-presentation syntax without changing the mathematical statement.
